tasks.title: Tactical Box Breathing for Stress Reset
tasks.shortDescription: 4-4-4-4 diaphragmatic breathing to rapidly lower heart rate and cortisol
tasks.purpose: Activates vagus nerve, clears cognitive fatigue, and restores autonomic nervous system control.

instructions.title: Inhale 4 Seconds
instructions.body: Inhale slowly through your nose into the low belly for 4 counts.

instructions.title: Hold 4 Seconds
instructions.body: Pause gently with relaxed throat for 4 counts.

instructions.title: Exhale 4 Seconds
instructions.body: Exhale smoothly through lips for 4 counts.

instructions.title: Hold Empty 4 Seconds
instructions.body: Remain empty and calm for 4 counts. Repeat for 6 complete rounds.
